verdict.decision_rule: SAFETY_DISCHARGED only if every obligation in the mechanism has an explicit validity contract, every required precondition is established by its callers at the candidate, and no safe interface can cause UB. OWNERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTED only if a safe ownership model exists and the residual boundary is identified without an unestablished caller precondition. Otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED.
verdict.statement: The section-7 criterion-3 whole-closure safety argument is ESTABLISHED for one mechanism and NOT ESTABLISHED for six at b80 (1 SAFETY_DISCHARGED (scoped) / 0 OWNERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTED / 6 NOT_ESTABLISHED). The two b80b closures are ACCEPTED and discharge 290/290 obligations at the tool's site level with 0 BLOCKED / 0 UNKNOWN, element 7 PASS (156 contract-bounded, 0 target-bounded, 0 unclassified), and all 290 obligations have now been reviewed by an independent reader (116 EVP + 122 X509 + 52 rest). Contract coverage is 278 fn-level / 2 operation-level-safeonly / 6 contracted-record / 4 no-contract. The reviews were made at source tree 5b08c0294 (the reconversion review at 97a1240e7) while S is d9fdf1357: 6 src files changed in between, touching 22 obligation rows (12 RAND, 10 X509), of which the b80 review-rebind re-read and re-bound 4 at S; the other 18 are recorded as not re-established at S rather than silently transferred, and the 268 rows in unchanged files transfer by content identity. SSL_SESSION is the single SAFETY_DISCHARGED (scoped) mechanism, on the rest-final review's own verdict, with the retained C-ABI serialisation obligation named. RUNTIME_CONCURRENCY fails only for want of ThreadSanitizer on the two free_lock rows; C_ABI_CONTRACT and BIO remain UNSAFE_OPEN mechanism-wide; RAND retains 9 drifted rows, R2 and the secret-cleansing gap; X509 retains 9 drifted rows, 2 stale-kind rows and the review's own refusal to discharge; EVP excludes the provider dispatch-table and EVP_PKEY_CTX surfaces by its own scope statement. No Miri/ASan/TSan/Loom/dudect run supports any mechanism at b80. The candidate is therefore NOT graduated, and safe_compatible remains false.

residuals.statement: 18 of 290 obligations live in files changed between the reviews' tree (5b08c0294) and S (d9fdf1357) and were not re-read at S: RAND_CMS_STORE_KEYFMT:9, X509_VERIFY_POLICY:9. They are NOT treated as established by transfer.

RUNTIME_CONCURRENCY's two free_lock rows and its mechanism verdict are NOT_ESTABLISHED for want of ThreadSanitizer (with Loom for the LockState wait/notify protocol); no TSan or Loom run exists at S, and B60's reviewer was not independent.

C_ABI_CONTRACT (5 obligations) and BIO (2) are UNSAFE_OPEN mechanism-wide; the reviews closed the site defects, not the classification. BIO's site argument covers only the two empty-body operations in the closure.

156 reachable unresolved sites are contract-bounded by public ABI (0 target-bounded, 0 unclassified): each is resolved to a declared external ABI contract under section 7 criterion 2, not proven safe by this argument.

X509 retains F1's surrounding family: the guard fix for v2i_GENERAL_NAME_ex is established by an executing test at S, but 9 drifted v3_san.rs rows were not re-read, the 2 admission-record rows (i2s_poison, s2i_poison) need re-admission as EXTERN_C_FN_DEF, 5 openssh-v1l rows were reviewed at b78 only, 24 orphan rows sit outside the current upper bound, and the review states it discharges nothing.

RAND_CMS_STORE_KEYFMT retains 9 drifted rows, b80-rebind R2 (the two CMS free # Safety texts say 'exactly-once release' where the call releases a reference), 2 operation-level-only contracts, ossl_rand_ctx_free's repair not independently re-read at S, and no secret-cleansing audit.

the reconversion review is bound to its own source identity 97a1240e7 and 18 src files changed between it and S, so its findings are carried at S as unresolved obligations of a known defect class: D1 (11 of the 12 qualifier-control tests are self-satisfying, so removing `unsafe` from 23 of the 24 converted declarations would not fail any test), D2 (SSL_COMP_get_name) and D5 (OPENSSL_init_ssl # Safety under-specifies the settings obligations). No reviewer re-checked them at S.
no Miri (Stacked/Tree Borrows), ASan, TSan, Loom or dudect/ctgrind run at S; the argument is source/closure-level plus the gate's own unit tests.
the operation-span content hash explicitly excludes caller closures; caller evidence is what the reviews read, row by row.
the safe-surface numbers are lexical: trait-object dispatch, generics, closures and macro-expanded call edges are not resolved, and re-exports are not followed.
